title: Claude Code Sessions
description: Settings for the Claude Code sessions side panel.

presentationMode.title: Presentation mode
presentationMode.description: How session rows are labelled. `folder` (default) shows the session name Claude records for the project (so a `/rename` shows through), falling back to the project folder name when no session name exists and walking up the path to disambiguate when two projects share a basename. `path` shows the project path relative to the JupyterLab notebook root (absolute if outside it).

recentLimit.title: Recent items count
recentLimit.description: Number of rows shown in the Recent section, sorted by last activity (descending).

dangerouslySkipPermissions.title: Dangerously skip permissions
dangerouslySkipPermissions.description: When enabled, newly spawned and resumed sessions are launched with `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. Bypasses every Claude Code permission prompt - only enable in sandboxes you trust.

sidebar.title: Sidebar position
sidebar.description: Which JupyterLab sidebar to dock the panel to. `left` (default) keeps it next to the file browser. `right` puts it opposite. Takes effect on the next JupyterLab reload.
